LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: COLLECTIVE NOUNS.

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns.

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns.. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do collective nouns form their plurals?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify collective nouns from a text
2. use singular and plural forms of collective nouns correctly in sentences
3. appreciate the importance of collective nouns in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: COLLECTIVE NOUNS.
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

3. appreciate the importance of collective nouns in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

2. Explain Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns..

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. important for a Grade 8 learner?

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT
